summary: Dorje Tseten worked in Tibetology and history and archaeology. He studied education at Beijing Normal University (~1944–1948) and served as director of the China Tibetology Research Center from 1986 to 2000.

Dorji Banzarov was a scholar in Iranian and Central Asian studies, religious studies, and linguistics. He studied at the First Kazan Male Gymnasium, the école militaire russo-mongole, and Kazan Imperial University (~1842–1846) under Józef Szczepan Kowalewski.

Dorji Wangchuk is a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar. After studying at Ngagyur Nyingma Institute, he earned an MA and PhD at the University of Hamburg under David P. Jackson and Lambert Schmithausen, becoming a professor there in 2009.

Dorothy C. Wong is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Sinology. She has held posts as a faculty member at the University of Virginia and as visiting Professor of Buddhist Art at the University of Hong Kong (attested 2009).

Douglas Allen is a scholar of philosophy and religious studies. He studied at Yale, Banaras Hindu University, and Vanderbilt, and taught at Southern Illinois University Carbondale and Central Connecticut State before joining the University of Maine as professor.

Douglas Fairchild Ober works in Indology, Buddhist studies, and history and archaeology. He studied at the University of Washington and completed his PhD at the University of British Columbia under Harjot Oberoi (attested 2016).
Douglas Gildow is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Sinology, and religious studies. He completed his PhD at Princeton University under Stephen F. Teiser and Qi Zhou (attested 2016).

Douglas Osto works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He earned an MA at the University of Washington and a PhD at SOAS under Ulrich Pagel (~2000–2004), later becoming Senior Lecturer at Massey University in 2005.

Douglas S. Duckworth is a scholar of Buddhist studies, philosophy, and Tibetology. He studied at James Madison University and the University of Virginia, completing his PhD under Jeffrey Hopkins, and served as Assistant Professor at East Tennessee State University.
Dragana Majhen works in religious studies and Buddhist studies. She earned a master's degree at the University of Manitoba under thesis advisor Albert Welter (attested 2010).

Dragomir Dimitrov is an Indology, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology scholar. He completed his MA and PhD at the University of Marburg under Michael Hahn and later served there as Dr. habil., as well as with the Nepalese-German Manuscript Cataloguing Project.

Dramdul works in Tibetology, Indology, and Buddhist studies. He served as Director at the China Tibetology Research Center (attested 2004–2012) and editor-in-chief for Sanskrit Texts from the Tibetan Autonomous Region (attested 2013–2020).
Drodul Dorji Tenzin studied under Dudjom Rinpoche and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje.

Drodul Pawo Dorje studied under Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye, Patrul Rinpoche, Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso, and Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo. His students included Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, Ayu Khandro, and Khunu Lama Tenzin Gyaltsen.
Drolkar Chungchung studied under Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye and Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo.
Drolma is a Tibetology scholar who studied under Hanna Havnevik and completed an M.Phil in Tibetan Studies at the University of Oslo (attested 2008).
Drubwang Shakya Shri studied under Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye (~1880–1899), Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo (~1880–1892), and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso. He taught Lobsang Phuntshok Lhalungpa.

id: P:Drukpa Ku Chen Chöying Rolwé Dorjé
summary: Drukpa Ku Chen Chöying Rolwé Dorjé studied under Patrul Rinpoche and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso.
Drukpa Lama Rik Drol Gyatso studied under Patrul Rinpoche and Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo.

Dudjom Jigdral Yeshe Dorje worked in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under Gyurme Ngedon Wangpo and Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, and his students included Keith Dowman, Sogyal Rinpoche, and Khetsun Sangpo Rinpoche.
